slots.title: Aug. 19 session: indexes, retail, chips, tape
slots.body:
U.S. equity benchmarks finished in the green on Aug. 19.
The S&P 500 closed at 7,708.03 (+0.2%), the Nasdaq Composite at 26,331.09 (+0.2%), and the Dow at 53,463.05 (+0.2%).
The Russell 2000 outpaced them at 3,032.94 (+0.5%).

The VIX ended at 14.89, down 6.0% from the prior close of 15.84.
Session headlines included the Treasury Department’s longer-dated bond buyback messaging and the release of FOMC minutes (scheduled high-impact at 6:00 p.m.
ET on the economic calendar).

On Nasdaq sector averages, Consumer Cyclical led at +2.8% and Healthcare at +2.4%.
Technology lagged at -1.5%, Industrials at -1.7%, and Financial Services at -0.5%.
Energy averaged -0.5%.

Megacap and large-cap moves were split.
Apple closed at 316.83 (+2.2%).
Tesla at 351.12 (+4.2%).
Salesforce at 206.09 (+5.1%).
Netflix at 80.22 (+3.2%).
Microsoft at 484.31 (+0.6%).
On the downside, Broadcom finished at 362.48 (-4.6%), AMD at 466.42 (-3.7%), NVIDIA at 217.56 (-1.0%), and Intel at 92.80 (-4.0% in actives).
JPMorgan closed at 357.26 (-1.6%).

Retail and consumer earnings drove several named moves.
Target reported EPS of 4.11 vs 2.35 estimated and revenue above estimate; the stock closed at 159.03 (+4.3%), touching a 161.98 day high vs a 52-week high of 161.98 in the profile data.
Lowe’s posted EPS 4.40 vs 4.22 estimated with revenue slightly below estimate; shares ended at 220.71 (+2.4%).
TJX beat on EPS (1.22 vs 1.19) with revenue slightly above estimate but closed at 144.50 (-4.2%).
Estée Lauder reported EPS 0.39 vs 0.32 estimated and revenue above estimate; the stock surged to 98.01 (+16.3%).
Analog Devices beat on EPS (3.45 vs 3.34) and revenue; shares still closed at 373.26 (-0.9%).

Moderna was a standout in actives, closing at 174.38 (+177.0%).
Bitcoin ETF proxies also saw heavy activity: iShares Bitcoin Trust at 38.78 (+6.0%) and ProShares Bitcoin ETF at 9.25 (+6.0%), while spot Bitcoin in the cross-asset block finished at 69,344.98 (+0.1%).

Cross-asset and rates context from the injected snapshot: gold futures at 4,563.30 (+0.4%), Brent crude at 92.09 (+0.5%), and the dollar-proxy ETF UUP at 27.88 (-0.9%).
EUR/USD printed 1.17 (-0.1%).
Treasury yields in the Aug. 17 FMP treasury block showed the 10-year at 4.7% and the 30-year at 5.3%, with a 2s10s spread of 0.53.

Overseas indexes in the bundle included the Nikkei 225 at 66,137.49 (+1.2%) and the FTSE 100 at 10,743.35 (+0.1%).
Japan export data showing accelerated growth on chip shipments appeared in the day’s news flow alongside U.S. debt passing $40 trillion in reported coverage.
